story:
Two passes cross the south of Snowdonia, one toward the southern valleys and one toward the Pennines, and both are older than the roads Rome laid over them. The shepherds say the soldiers who keep them are older than the roads too: dead men in harness of a pattern no armourer of Camelot can name, from a war before the last legion came, who were set to hold the passes by someone who never came back to relieve them.

The Snowdon Grim keeps the pass toward the Pennines, and he is a hoarder. Whatever is carried through his pass, he takes, and keeps, in a heap among the rocks: drovers' crooks, a friar's bell, a lieutenant's sword, more than one hammer. When the Church lost the glacial hammer every knight of Castle Sauvage knew where it had gone. The Grim did not have it. He never had it. He has everything else, and the Church cannot quite believe that the one thing it wanted is not in the heap.
legend: Snowdon Grim, level 36-38 ghost legionnaire at the Snowdonia/Pennine pass. Aggro level 70, so he often jumps you. Plain melee. For Crushed Faith you kill him and get 'still no hammer': that is the quest, keep going (grave goblin in the Barrows, then Dash by Caer Boldiam at night). Crush on the bones. Respawn five minutes. His heap of junk is scenery; there is nothing in it for you.

aggro: Leave it. Leave all of it.

lairEntry: A dead soldier on a heap of other men's things.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The Snowdon Grim has fallen. His heap is unguarded.
